name: Grainbloom
author: Lightlike
summary: Granular texture and micro-loop effect. Seven modes (Collage, Cloud, Stutter, Shimmer, Shatter, Arpeggio, Cascade) slice, scatter and pitch the recent past into rhythmic loops or ambient washes, with tempo sync, freeze, feedback and a lush plate/hall reverb. Grain, Scatter, Space and Mix macros on a touch skin.
